principle: People form a stable judgement of a page's appeal within about 50 milliseconds, long before they read anything.
detect: A first viewport whose overall shape, colour and image quality look generic or cluttered.
fix: Treat the first viewport as a single composition: one strong image or art element, one headline, calm colour.

source.title: Attention web designers: You have 50 milliseconds to make a good first impression!
source.author: Lindgaard, Fernandes, Dudek & Brown (2006)
